# Employee Welcome Kits & Executive Gift Sets

## **Joining Kit for Employees**

### **Personalized New Employee Welcome Kit**

Welcome aboard! Joining kits for employees is like a friendly handshake from day one. They're part of the cool initiation process for new joiners, making them feel cozy and part of the team right away.

But apart from a gesture; the company welcome kit is a symbol of excitement and positivity. Our joining kit for new employees creates an onboarding experience that's not just welcoming but downright thrilling. We believe in starting things off on a high note, and these kits make sure you dive into your journey with a big smile.

### **Explore Our Collection of Joining Kits for Employees**

- #### **Classic Budget-Friendly Corporate Gift Hamper**


Discover the charm of our simple budget-friendly [corporate gift sets](https://pebel.in/pages/corporate-gifting)! Unwrap a world of practicality and delight with a [unique water bottle](https://pebel.in/collections/bottles) – perfect for staying hydrated at work. The all-in-one travel organizer makes their on-the-go days a breeze, and the silicone tag adds a touch of uniqueness. To sweeten the deal, we've included some delectable chocolates, all bundled up in a neat hamper box. It's a thoughtful and wallet-friendly way to spread some joy around the office!

- #### **Coffee Lover's Employee Treat**


Calling all coffee aficionados! Feast your eyes on this [gift hamper box](https://pebel.in/collections/gift-sets) – a coffee lover's dream come true. They can sip in style with a customized glass mug, complete with a trendy silicone sleeve. Perfect to keep their thoughts organized in a sleek diary featuring a leather-like cover, and jot them down with the accompanying metal pen. Fuel their day with the rich flavors of Sleepy Owl Coffee, in some scrumptious flavored chocolate, and top it all off with a heartfelt card.

- #### **Fresh Start Employee Onboarding Kit**


Welcome your new team members with an onboarding kit! Unveil the journey with our selection of welcome gifts to new employees, starring the Align A5 Hardcover Notebook, a sleek 550ml Signature bottle, a classy metal pen, and a thoughtful card. It's a fresh beginning filled with inspiration and practical goodies!

- #### **Ultimate Eco Bundle Happiness Employee Gift Pack**


Embrace happiness the eco-friendly way! Our ultimate office welcome kit is a green delight. They can enjoy sipping from the sleek [tumbler glass](https://pebel.in/collections/mugs-and-tumblers), and top it off with a cotton cap. A cotton tote bag to carry essentials savor some chocolate sweetness and don't forget the heartfelt card. It's a bundle of joy with the planet in mind.

- #### **Employee Welcome Joining Kit**


Cheers to new beginnings! Our welcome kit box is a burst of good wishes and appreciation for any occasion. Dive into a personalized oasis bottle, discover the all-in-one new employee welcome kit, find convenience in a metal mobile holder, and feel the warmth of a heartfelt card. Here's to the start of something wonderful!

- #### **All-in-One Employee Corporate Gift Hamper**


Unbox the excitement with our all-in-one corporate welcome kit! Packed with essentials for a thriving workspace – a branded ceramic mug for coffee, a comfy polo neck t-shirt, a practical mouse pad, a stylish metal keychain, and some cool stickers. It's the perfect all-inclusive welcome for your fantastic team members. Let's make every day at work a celebration!

- #### **Classic Corporate Employee Joining Kit**


Get ready to kickstart your journey with our classic corporate employee joining kit! Unbox a world of goodies, including a customized glass bottle with a sleek steel lid, a cozy zipper hoodie to keep you snug, a world diary to jot down your thoughts, a professional metal pen, and a card to welcome you to the team.

- #### **Executive Corporate Gift Hamper - Signature Pebel Gift Set**


Introducing our executive corporate gift hamper – the Signature Pebel Gift Set! Elevate your new hire welcome gifts with this exquisite set, customizable with logos and names for that personalized touch. It's not just a gift; it's a statement of appreciation and sophistication. The perfect way to leave a lasting impression from day one!

- #### **New Employee Joining Welcome Kits**


Welcome them aboard with memorable welcome gifts for new employees! Dive into the elegance of our borosilicate glass bottle – not just stylish, but practical too. Its unique design lets you see the water level and contents inside. With a Double Locking Lid, wide-mouth access for easy additions like ice cubes or citrus slices, and easy cleaning, it's a blend of beauty and functionality.

### **Buy Welcome Gifts for New Employees Online with Pebel**

Discover a world of personalized welcome gifts for new employees with Pebel Lifeware. Our commitment lies in enhancing lifestyles with completely customizable essentials. At Pebel, we take pride in crafting products that embody minimalistic, classic designs while ensuring functionality and sustainability.

Whether it's a sleek glass bottle, a stylish hoodie, or an elegant pen, our range of welcome gifts reflects our dedication to offering thoughtful and high-quality items. For an extra touch, consider thoughtful gifts such as a personalized [tiffin lunch box](https://pebel.in/collections/lunch-boxes), adding a practical and personal element to their welcome.
